name: salvo-vscode
description: Syntax highlighting and language server support for the Salvo programming language.

salvo.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `salvo` binary used to start the language server (`salvo lsp`). Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder, so e.g. `target/debug/salvo` points at a freshly built compiler in this repository.

salvo.backend.markdownDescription: Optional backend passed to the language server as `--backend <name>` (e.g. `kotlin` or `rust`). Selects which backend define files (`*.<backend>.sv`) participate in analysis; empty means backend-neutral.
